messages:
Mia (Partnerships): Quick sync — we need to finalize hybrid billing window for MP private offers with Acme Appliance and SI launch. Proposed: 12-mo commit with 3-mo ramp credits, 10% discount for appliance bundles, 5% renewal credit.
Sam (Sales): Agree on window but need to check cloud marketplace billing cycles (Azure vs AWS). AWS requires 1-mo lead for private offer visibility.
Jordan (Finance): Finance POV: 12-mo commit ok; need modeled revenue recognition + deferred credits. Share baseline numbers before legal review.
Mia (Partnerships): @Jordan can you post the sensitivity table? We need to confirm impact on MR and unit economics.
Jordan (Finance): Uploaded quick table: ```
sku,commit,discount,rev_delta
APPL-XL,500k,10%,-40k
MP-CORE,200k,5%,-12k
```
Ciara (SI PM): From SI: we need 45 day lead for co-branded announcement and joint webinar. Also embedding/integration services should be a separate SKU (so we don't cannibalize appliance credits).
Alex (Legal): I'll draft private offer terms: include usage floors, early termination clawback, and KMS/HSM language for on-prem. Note: marketplace terms may need vendor acceptance windows.
Sam (Sales): Ops question — do we route customers to Dedicated vs Hosted by default? That changes invoicing cadence and SLA calls out in the PO.
Mia (Partnerships): Proposed rule: Hosted for pilots and <1M annual commit, Dedicated for >=1M commits. Add an explicit migration path and pro-rated billing.
Jordan (Finance): Quick ask: can we convert 3-mo ramp credits into a 1-time onboarding credit instead? Simpler for rev and reporting.
Ciara (SI PM): SI strongly prefers ramp as service credits (hours) vs dollar credit — ensures enablement gets consumed and ties to success metrics.
Mia (Partnerships): Decision attempt: keep ramp as service credits for SI enablement, but also offer a one-time onboarding dollar credit on the marketplace invoice to simplify partner accounting. @Alex please reflect both options in the PO.
Sam (Sales): Marketing FYI — target announce date 2025-11-15. We need product + partner assets by 2025-10-30 for the marketplace listing and co-announcement.
Mia (Partnerships): Action items recap: @Jordan model final numbers by 2025-10-20; @Alex draft PO + dual-credit language by 2025-10-25; @Ciara finalize SI delivery hours and SOW by 2025-10-22; @Sam confirm announce cadence and assets by 2025-10-27.
Marketing Team Bot: Added milestones to shared roadmap calendar and created task cards.
Sam (Sales): Acknowledged :thumbsup:
Jordan (Finance): Will upload updated sensitivity sheet to the shared folder: https://redwood.app/sheets/hybrid-billing (will include ARR, CAC impact, gross margin scenarios).
Alex (Legal): Looping Security for KMS/HSM and data residency language. Also flagging that AWS private offer acceptance can take up to 7 business days.
Ciara (SI PM): SI will propose a 20-hour enablement play tied to appliance installs; will convert hours to service-credit SKU for tracking.
Mia (Partnerships): Great — barring surprises we'll lock terms next week and route to partner legal. Thanks team!
